evidence_labels.MEASURED: Read directly from a source artifact.
evidence_labels.DERIVED: Computed or normalized from measured data.
evidence_labels.OPEN: No approved value is available. Do not use it as a default.

navy.source: MEASURED: Collibra Brand Guidelines 2026.07, p.16. Primary dark for headings and dark section backgrounds.

lime.source: MEASURED: Collibra Brand Guidelines 2026.07, p.16. Primary accent for CTA fills, eyebrow ticks, and rules.

forest.source: MEASURED: Collibra Brand Guidelines 2026.07, p.16. Secondary accent for links on light surfaces, tags, and charts.

light_forest.source: MEASURED: Collibra Brand Guidelines 2026.07, p.16. Soft panel and tag-pill fill.

charcoal.source: MEASURED: Collibra Brand Guidelines 2026.07, p.16. Body and eyebrow text on light surfaces.

cloud.source: MEASURED: Collibra Brand Guidelines 2026.07, p.16. Body text on dark surfaces and hairlines.

light_cloud.source: MEASURED: Collibra Brand Guidelines 2026.07, p.16. Light section and card background.

white.source: MEASURED: Collibra Brand Guidelines 2026.07, p.16. Light background and text on dark surfaces.

black.source: MEASURED: Collibra 2026 PPTX theme, dk1 slot.

followed_link.source: OPEN, MEASURED: Collibra 2026 PPTX theme, folHlink slot. It is outside the published palette and needs a brand-team ruling.

ramp.source: MEASURED: Collibra Brand Guidelines 2026.07, p.17. Do not use ramp steps for body text without a contrast check.

gradient.source: OPEN: Collibra Brand Guidelines 2026.07, p.18 shows gradients without published stop values. Use navy as the flat fallback until stops are supplied.

display.source: MEASURED: Collibra Brand Guidelines 2026.07, pp.22-23. Use for assets, web, and creative work, except presentations.

presentation.source: MEASURED: Collibra Brand Guidelines 2026.07, p.22. Use for Slides and PowerPoint presentations.

mono.source: MEASURED: Collibra Brand Guidelines 2026.07, p.23. Use only for all-caps eyebrows and tags.

regular.source: MEASURED: Collibra 2026 PPTX font-size census. Used by subtitle, body, and caption styles.

bold.source: MEASURED: Collibra 2026 PPTX font-size census. Used by display and title styles.

scale.source: OPEN: The doc-suite records no approved Collibra spacing scale. Do not create or use numeric spacing defaults until the brand team supplies them.

MEASURED: Collibra Brand Guidelines 2026.07, p.34. "A 4px (0.25rem) corner radius is applied to many, if not all, UI components in this design system. Especially elements that act as containers to content." Single value, not a scale -- the source publishes one radius, not a ramp.
